data.title: One pathway for every international patient.
data.sub: Before travel, before going home, and long after they are back in their own country — the same place to find NeuroGen, book a consult, and be seen.

data.title: An international patient is handled across four disconnected channels.

items.label: Calls across time zones, with no record of what was agreed
Reports and scans arrive in a thread nobody owns
Follow-up is confirmed verbally, then chased

data.note: Nothing connects them. The patient restarts the process every time, and NeuroGen carries the coordination.

data.title: Doctaz does not replace NeuroGen's clinical care.
data.sub: It gives the relationship around that care a single place to live, so the patient can always find their way back to NeuroGen. Specialist treatment, travel and admission stay exactly as NeuroGen runs them today.

data.title: One repeatable pathway, not four channels.

items.d: The patient finds NeuroGen's clinicians and their availability from their own country.
Slots are shown in the patient's own time zone, not the hospital's.
A secure video consult inside the same app, free within the facility.
The next appointment is booked before the call ends. Then it repeats.

data.title: The patient is home, and needs a follow-up.

steps.d: Previously treated at NeuroGen, now back in their own country. The pathway is already there.
The same NeuroGen clinician, not a new phone number.
Slots shown in the patient's own time zone.
Patient reads Pending; the clinician reads Requested. Same appointment, same time.
A secure video consult inside the same app.

data.title: The follow-up is booked before the patient leaves India.

steps.d: Connected while the patient is still in front of the team.
The one who actually treated them.
The next touchpoint exists before departure.
Nothing depends on the patient remembering.
The transition home changes nothing the patient has to learn.

data.title: Discovery abroad, through to post-treatment follow-up.

steps.d: Specialty search, before any phone call or contact form.
Profile, rating and availability in one place.
An assessment before committing to travel.
A real consult before the flight is booked.
The relationship created before travel is the one used after it.

data.title: Two real phones. One live consult.
data.sub: Captured between two Android phones on 6 Oct 2026. The clinician dials, it rings in about three seconds, and both sides reach Connected. Camera imagery is represented — the call, signalling, controls and pricing are real.
points: The clinician dials, so the patient is never asked to pay to be seen
Rings like a normal phone call and answers in seconds
A second specialist can be added mid-consult

data.title: The same appointment, on both phones.
data.sub: The brief's acceptance criteria ask that patient and provider views show the same scheduled appointment. They do — and both read it in their own time zone.
points: Patient books the slot and sees Pending
The clinician sees the same appointment as Requested
Thu 8 Oct, 10:00 AM on both, reference APT-89

data.title: Configuration, not an integration project.

items.d: A hospital environment with its own name and member list.
Each doctor, APRN and nurse is added once.
Inside NeuroGen the per-appointment country fee is waived, so a clinician confirms in one tap.

data.note: Outside a facility, India's country rate adds a ₹700 appointment fee the clinician settles on approval. Inside NeuroGen that is waived — which is the commercial difference being offered.

data.title: What NeuroGen gets out of it.

items.label: A front door that works from abroad, before the patient ever calls
Follow-up that survives the flight home, with the right local time
Coordination lifted off reception and into one shared place

data.note: Each consult continues the last one rather than restarting it, because the history travels with the patient.

data.title: The international patient should not need a different pathway at every stage.
data.sub: One environment supports connection, scheduling, consultation and repeated follow-up — before travel, before returning home, and after the patient is back in their own country.
We set up the NeuroGen environment, onboard the clinicians and cover the pilot. NeuroGen changes nothing about how it treats patients.
